citation: Edwards’ Annual Directory of the City of Chicago, 1871. Fourteenth annual issue. Chicago: Richard Edwards, 1871.
author: Richard Edwards, publisher/compiler
locator: Printed pages 34, 43, 53, 161, 1016 and 1031, plus other inspected pages identified in chicago/pre_fire_v1/data/field_notebook_1871.json. Preserved page images in chicago/pre_fire_v1/media/research/. T-3805: City and County Record, 'Fire Alarm and Police Telegraph', printed pp. 34-35 (the fire-alarm stations by number and corner, djvu.txt lines 2348-2700), and the classified business directory's 'Barbers' and 'Cigars and Tobacco (Retail)' (djvu.txt from lines 260830 and 264086), read from the Internet Archive OCR text; transcribed in chicago/4d/data/research/street_furniture_1871.json.
rights_note: Original United States publication dated 1871, public domain by age. The existing notebook records Internet Archive metadata NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT and University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign provenance.
access_notes: Uses the existing inspected primary-page notebook. Historical addresses retain their original numbering; they have not been substituted with modern geocodes.
what_it_supplies: Occupations, business categories, institution names and historical addresses for further location research.
Evidence for varied commercial, residential and industrial uses.
The fire-alarm telegraph's street stations by number and corner, and firms the classified pages put at a named corner (T-3805).
what_it_does_not_supply: Modern coordinates, measured footprints, facades, exact people present at 16:30 or guaranteed October occupancy for every listing.
note: Used for district character and future property research. Generic context buildings are not assigned invented directory occupants. The directory is not an exhaustive resident census.
